title: VDCores Qwen3 1.7B Single-Visible-GPU Diagnostic
command: Run Qwen3-1.7B with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, offline Hugging Face cache, QWEN1P7B_NO_PREFETCH=all, one-layer final_rms launch, then one-layer full-schedule launch.
observation: Restricting visibility to physical GPU 7 makes the one-layer final_rms launch return status 0, resolving the previous direct 1D cp_async_bulk illegal memory access. The one-layer full schedule still fails later with an illegal instruction.
blocker: Co-locating model weights and launcher buffers resolves the earliest final_rms launch failure, but the one-layer full schedule still fails with illegal instruction. VDCores still lacks full correctness and queue/resource-policy timing for paper comparison.

summary.full_one_layer_error: launch_dae failed: an illegal instruction was encountered
rules_out: cross-device Qwen weight placement as the sole cause of the one-layer final_rms failure
summary.next_debug_target: debug the co-located one-layer full-schedule illegal instruction before collecting VDCores correctness or resource-policy timing
